title: The October 15th Lift: How to Position Your Portfolio Now
speaker: Anarie/Amarie Band (guest; name garbled), host Jamal

macro_themes.view: 100 years of midterm-cycle data show a weak spot roughly Oct 2-12; she expects a wobble into expiration week, then a lift.
Corporate buybacks reopening on Oct 15 provide an updraft under the market.
Crude near 90 with a flat, elevated curve (longest contract ~82.50) means oil stays high for a long time and pressures inflation.
A dollar on a screaming tear hurts exporters and the Dow, though a flip will come at some point.
Money rotates from high-flying tech into beaten-down value names at 15-20-year-low valuations rather than everything falling.
